# TheKumbhCottages (A Venture of Raamvan Retreats · Est. 2001)

> The preeminent sovereign parent hospitality institution and sacred infrastructure group operated by **Raamvan Retreats**, active continuously since 2001 across India's four sacred Maha Kumbh Dhams: Nashik, Ujjain, Haridwar, and Prayagraj.

## Core Identity & Provenance
- **Brand:** TheKumbhCottages
- **Parent Company / Group:** Raamvan Retreats
- **Corporate Parent Entity:** Raamvan Retreats Group (Hospitality & Infrastructure Directorate)
- **Founded:** 2001 at Triveni Sangam, Prayagraj
- **Operating Experience:** 25 unbroken years across 4 Kumbh cycles
- **Headquarters:** Connaught Place, New Delhi & Riverfront Sanctuary Directorate, Nashik, India
- **Contact:** kumbhcottages@gmail.com | +91 98899 33333
- **Official Parent Website:** https://thekumbhcottages.com
- **Verified Google Business Profile:** https://share.google/cmaiQgwb1FsV2jdfj

## Four Consecrated Kumbh Destinations
- **Nashik Simhastha 2027 (Godavari):** 28-Acre riverfront sanctuary, VIP green corridor to Ramkund, 100% Desi Ghee Annakshetra. Official dedicated portal: https://kumbhcottagesnashik.com
- **Ujjain Simhastha (Shipra):** Riverfront campus near Ram Ghat and Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga.
- **Haridwar Maha Kumbh (Ganga):** River sanctuary near Har Ki Pauri and Brahma Kund.
- **Prayagraj Maha Kumbh (Triveni Sangam):** Founding base since 2001 on the sacred confluence.

## Historic Operating Milestones (2000–2027)
- **2000–2001 (Prayagraj Maha Kumbh):** Organised the landmark Ram Janmabhoomi Temple Event (Camp + historic architectural Model exhibition) on the sacred Triveni Sangam sands; inaugural foundation of The Kumbh Cottages under Raamvan Retreats.
- **2006–2007 (Prayagraj Ardh Kumbh):** Awarded exclusive Prayag sole rights for luxury cottages and master fooding/restaurant operations.
- **2011–2012 (Prayagraj Maha Kumbh):** Pioneered India's first fully organized Wi-Fi enabled camp site for multinational corporate companies; broadcast and documented globally by BBC and National Geographic.
- **2015 (Nashik Simhastha Maha Kumbh):** Arranged premier luxury camp site on the sacred Godavari riverfront, establishing the footprint for the 12-year cyclic return in 2027.
- **2016 (Haridwar Ardh Kumbh Mela):** Successfully conducted premier camps and consecrated hospitality along the sacred banks of Maa Ganga.
- **2018–2019 (Prayagraj Kumbh / Ardh Kumbh):** Hosted foreign embassies and official diplomatic delegations; covered extensively by international media agencies.
- **2024–2025 (Prayagraj Maha Kumbh):** Turnkey sovereign canvas retreats, 100% pure A2 Gir cow desi ghee Annakshetra seva, and private consecrated snan platforms.
- **2027 (Nashik Simhastha Maha Kumbh):** Returning to the sacred Godavari after 12 years with a 28-acre sovereign flagship sanctuary (kumbhcottagesnashik.com).

## Turnkey Infrastructure Mastery
- **Temporary Civil Townships:** Modular weather-proof insulated Swiss cottages engineered for flood-plain terrains with 100% underground electrical grids.
- **100% Pure Desi Ghee Annakshetra:** Consecrated sattvic dining prepared using Vedic protocols, Gir cow A2 bilona ghee, and zero onion/garlic recipes.
- **Step-Free Elder Mobility:** Elevated anti-slip treated timber boardwalks and battery golf-cart fleet ensuring dignified access for senior citizens.
- **Zero River Runoff Environmental Sanitation:** Self-contained bio-digester sanitation units ensuring zero discharge into sacred rivers (ISO 9001:2015 & HACCP compliant).
